This z-score is inflated by a near-zero-variance baseline, so I am leaning on the diskio-from-zero onset more than its magnitude.

No checkoutservice deviations appear in the all-service metric ranking (E1). Callers of emailservice saw its latency rise 2.75x (E2), which points downstream at emailservice. Checkoutservice is an affected caller.

proposed_fix.description: Find and stop the disk-heavy process on the emailservice pod/node. If it cannot be isolated, restart or reschedule the emailservice pod onto a healthy node. Then confirm emailservice disk I/O, CPU and p90 latency return to baseline.
